note: Review state of every web localization, the way the iOS catalog marks `needs_review` (docs/07 section 1, D41). No native reader has read any of these strings, so every one is needs_review; that is information for whoever reads the pages later, not a release gate. Only a human reviewer turns a locale or a key to `translated`: list the keys they read in `reviewedKeys`. Never promoted by Claude Code. es-419 and en-GB are derived by scripts/derive-locales.py from es-MX and en plus src/i18n/overrides/.
